name: Westerville Weeknight Whimsy 2026
information: This competition does not include 3x3 and therefore may not be suitable for newer competitors. Please see [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) for a list of other upcoming competitions in Ohio. This competition also takes place on a **Thursday Evening**. Please plan accordingly! Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.
